configuration.eeg_processing: 21-channel average reference; continuous causal fourth-order Butterworth 0.1-40Hz; no ICA
configuration.features: 63 log std features from three consecutive 50-point windows
configuration.target_processing: raw wrist XYZ; subtract own onset position; no target filter/resampling
configuration.primary_metric: MAE over all trials, 500 time samples and XYZ
secondary_metrics: trial wins vs training mean trajectory
configuration.plots: mean trajectories and first trial; no best/worst trial selection

alignment_audit: passed internal time, Lift sequence and sampled HS/WS C3/XYZ checks; physical units unconfirmed
scope: one new subject, fixed prior configuration; not five-subject LOSO or full paper reproduction
